description: Change type on a path (Type > Type on a Path and Type on a Path Options): apply an effect (rainbow, skew, 3D ribbon, stair step, gravity), slide the text along the path with start and end, set spacing, flip the text to the other side of the path, or update legacy path type. Align to Path (baseline, ascender, descender, centre) is only in the dialog and is not offered

effect.description: Type > Type on a Path effect

flip.description: true: flip the text to the other side of the path, by reversing the path's direction (Object > Path > Reverse Path Direction). Flipping again flips back

spacing.description: Spacing (Type on a Path Options): space added between characters on tight curves, in points

start.description: Where the text starts, 0 (path start) to 1 (path end), counted by segments

target.description: Text frames (groups are searched for them). Give ids, names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

updateLegacy.description: true: Type > Type on a Path > Update Legacy Type on a Path, first

name: set_path_text
title: Set Path Text
